name: Applied Digital Polaris Forge 3
summary: Applied Digital's fourth AI factory campus, in Center, Oliver County, North Dakota. In May 2026 the company announced a 15-year take-or-pay lease with an unnamed US high investment-grade hyperscaler for 300 MW of critical IT load, supported by about 430 MW of grid-connected utility power, worth about 7.5 billion US dollars over the base term. The May release withheld the state; the company's October 2026 earnings release names Center, North Dakota. The campus is under construction, with initial operations targeted for 2027.

location.note: Town centroid of Center from its Wikipedia coordinates (s4). The October 2026 earnings release (s3) names Center, Oliver County; no parcel or address has been found.

metrics.note: Critical IT load leased to an unnamed US high investment-grade hyperscaler for 15 years, about 7.5 billion US dollars of base-term contracted revenue.
Grid-connected utility power supporting the campus.

milestones.note: Lease announcement; the location was described only as a northern state.
May 2026 target; the July 2026 results release says initial operations are expected during calendar 2027.

power_sources.description: About 430 MW of grid-connected utility power; the utility is not named in the cited sources.
